blueprint.name: BNK on a disconnected IBM ROKS cluster (private registry + F5 License Proxy)
blueprint.description: Install BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes onto an EXISTING IBM ROKS cluster that has no egress: images come from a private registry you have already mirrored, licensing from an F5 License Proxy. Registers the cluster with BNK Forge first, so it can be watched while BNK installs. Populate the mirror beforehand with the FAR mirror blueprint, or let the Harbor blueprint do it when it builds the registry.

outcomes: The BNK supply chain replicated into your private registry and verified
An existing air-gapped ROKS cluster adopted over the Transit Gateway
BNK installed with every image from the mirror and the License CR Active via the FLP

prerequisites.description: An IBM Cloud credential template on the project. Region and resource group inherit from it.
An existing, private ROKS cluster (no worker egress) on the Transit Gateway, with BNK NOT installed.

A private OCI registry (e.g. Harbor) reachable from both this runner and the cluster's nodes over the Transit Gateway. Its self-signed CA is captured automatically during replicate and installed on the nodes.
A running F5 License Proxy the cluster can reach privately — deploy one with the 'Deploying F5 License Proxy as an IBM Cloud VSI' blueprint, then paste its external_endpoint and root_ca_b64 here.
The existing Transit Gateway joining the cluster VPC to the services VPC holding the registry and the proxy.
An orchestration COS bucket holding the FAR auth tarball and the subscription JWT — the only artifacts not served from the mirror.

input_summary.label: Two phases
input_summary.value: Mirror (init -> registry replicate --target generic -> registry verify) then Install (cluster register -> bnk up -> bnk status), sharing one deployment workspace — the same split, and the same shared state, as the demo's two Argo Workflows over one PVC.

input_summary.label: Registry trust
input_summary.value: roksbnkctl captures the mirror's CA from its served chain during replicate, trusts it for the operator's own crane/helm/terraform pulls, and installs it on every worker node via its registry-trust DaemonSet before any image pull. Requires runner >= v1.33.0.

input_summary.label: Known gap
input_summary.value: The demo pairs `bnk up` with a cwc-guard sidecar that clears F5's ReadWriteOnce Multi-Attach deadlock on a REUSED cluster. A Forge container step is a single container with no sidecar, so that guard is not reproduced here — on a cluster where BNK was previously installed, licensing may stall until f5-spk-cwc is cycled by hand.

required.name: prefix
required.label: Resource prefix
required.description: Prefix for resource names roksbnkctl creates (e.g. acme-eu).

required.name: cluster_name
required.label: Existing cluster (name or ID)
required.description: Name or ID of the EXISTING ROKS cluster to adopt. It is never created and never destroyed by this blueprint.

required.name: region
required.label: IBM Cloud region
required.description: Region the cluster lives in. Inherits from the selected credential template.

required.name: resource_group
required.label: Resource group
required.description: IBM Cloud resource group. Inherits from the selected credential template.

required.name: existing_transit_gateway
required.label: Existing Transit Gateway (name or ID)
required.description: The EXISTING Transit Gateway the cluster's VPC is reached over. `cluster register` attaches the VPC to it; a VPC already attached is adopted, not re-created.

required.name: registry_generic_host
required.label: Private registry host
required.description: The private registry (e.g. Harbor) BNK's charts and images are mirrored into and pulled from. For an air-gapped cluster this is its PRIVATE IP or DNS name, reached over the Transit Gateway.

required.name: registry_password
required.label: Registry password
required.description: Password / access token for that user. Stored base64 in the workspace config, never logged.

required.name: flp_external_url
required.label: FLP endpoint
required.description: Licensing endpoint of an F5 License Proxy this cluster does NOT own — `flp output flp_external_endpoint` on the workspace that does.

required.name: flp_root_ca_b64
required.label: FLP root CA (base64)
required.description: That proxy's base64 root CA, which the cluster's CWC must trust — `flp output flp_root_ca`. Already base64: it is stored verbatim.

required.name: cos_bucket
required.label: Supply-chain COS bucket
required.description: Orchestration COS bucket holding the FAR auth tarball and the subscription JWT. The runner has no local copies, so it resolves them from here; buckets provisioned by `roksbnkctl init` carry a per-account suffix (bnk-artifacts-<account>).

optional.name: registry_repo_prefix
optional.label: Registry repository prefix
optional.description: Project / repository prefix inside the mirror (a Harbor project, an Artifactory repo key).

optional.name: registry_username
optional.label: Registry username
optional.description: Username the mirror is pushed to and pulled from.

optional.name: cos_instance
optional.label: Supply-chain COS instance
optional.description: COS instance holding the FAR auth key + subscription JWT. Blank = bnk-supply-chain.

optional.name: cos_region
optional.label: Supply-chain COS region
optional.description: Region of that bucket. Blank = us-south.

optional.name: far_auth_file
optional.label: FAR auth object name
optional.description: Object name of the FAR auth tarball in the bucket. Blank = f5-far-auth-key.tgz.

optional.name: subscription_jwt_file
optional.label: Subscription JWT object name
optional.description: Object name of the subscription JWT in the bucket. Blank = subscription.jwt.

optional.name: registry_cos_name
optional.label: Registry COS instance name
optional.description: Overrides the registry COS instance `cluster register` looks for. Blank = probe <prefix>-registry-cos, <cluster>-registry-cos, <cluster>-cos.

optional.name: manifest_version
optional.label: BNK manifest version
optional.description: BNK manifest release to install. Blank = the roksbnkctl default.

optional.name: bigip_url
optional.label: CIS BIG-IP URL

optional.description: BIG-IP username for CIS (optional).

optional.name: bigip_password

optional.name: registry_ca_b64
optional.label: Registry CA (base64)
optional.description: Base64 PEM of the private registry's CA. v1.35.0 REFUSES to auto-capture a self-signed mirror's CA over the wire, so supply it here (or pin it below) — this is the CA you generated for the registry.

optional.name: registry_ca_sha256
optional.label: Registry CA SHA-256 pin
optional.description: SHA-256 pin of the registry's served chain, enforced during the TLS handshake. Accepts bare hex, sha256:…, colon-separated, or raw `openssl x509 -fingerprint -sha256` output.

optional.name: bnkforge_url
optional.label: BNK Forge URL
optional.description: Register the adopted cluster with a BNK Forge instance so it appears on the Kubernetes page (e.g. https://forge.example.com). Blank = skip registration.

optional.name: bnkforge_username
optional.label: BNK Forge username
optional.description: Login for that Forge.

optional.name: bnkforge_password
optional.label: BNK Forge password
optional.description: Password for that login. Reaches the step as an environment variable only, never on the command line.

optional.name: bnkforge_project
optional.label: BNK Forge project
optional.description: Project the cluster is registered into. Blank = the workspace's configured project.

optional.name: bnkforge_insecure
optional.label: Skip Forge TLS verification
optional.description: Set true only for a Forge with a self-signed certificate. Defaults to false — verification stays on unless you opt out.

optional.name: flp_namespace
optional.label: FLP namespace
optional.description: Kubernetes namespace the F5 License Proxy client resources go into. Blank keeps the default the subscription JWT implies.

modules.name: roksbnkctl Cluster Registry
modules.description: Adopt the existing cluster and register it with BNK Forge — first, so it is visible and monitorable while BNK installs.

modules.name: roksbnkctl BNK Install
modules.description: init -> cluster register -> bnk up -> bnk status, pulling from the mirror and licensing via the FLP.

modules.name: cwc Multi-Attach guard
modules.description: Runs in PARALLEL with the BNK install, not before it: the Deployment it fixes only exists once the F5 Lifecycle Operator creates it, part-way through the install. Depends on the cluster registration for the kubeconfig. Leave it enabled — on a cluster that does not need it the patch reports 'no change' and the module is a few seconds of no-ops.
